steps.detail: Third party exploited a vulnerability in PLAID servers early on 13 Nov JST. CVE not disclosed
Stole connection credentials for systems and databases
Read data out of databases, including customer data imported via the linking table feature
Used stolen credentials to take over a PLAID account and access the admin console

steps.name: Exfiltration (channel not disclosed)
steps.detail: Data was read out to an external location. Method not disclosed
Risk: leaked integration secret keys and access tokens could be used against connected services. No abuse confirmed
